timeline: You are walking the halls of the New London School on March 18, 1937, completely unaware that deadly gas is pooling silently beneath your feet.
Invisible gas pooled silently beneath the school floors for months.
Then an instructor flipped a switch on an electric sander.
A spark ignited the trapped fumes in an instant.
Roughly three hundred people perished in the disaster.
School bus driver Lonnie Barber watched the horror unfold.
Investigators found the gas had zero warning scent.
So lawmakers ordered a potent sulfur compound added immediately.
That rotten-egg smell now saves millions of lives daily.
Why did a 1937 gas leak at the New London School force engineers to add mercaptan scent to natural gas worldwide?
